note: The fuzz harness enables PROXY protocol handling for the attacker-supplied input.
The input includes a valid HTTP terminator after the PROXY prelude.
Parsing enters the PROXY protocol dispatcher.
The first 16 bytes are interpreted as a PROXY v2 signature and header.
The attacker-controlled length field determines how much of the header is considered consumed.
